header: "FIND A FARE": the user says where they are going from Durgapur (or from Asansol, on the Asansol tab: `from="ASN"`, the fares from Asansol, in their own tables) and sees every train that goes there with its fare for each class. The fares to every stop were collected and SAVED while the plant's paid fare service lasted (src/lib/live/fareLegStore.ts), so this asks only the database (src/app/api/live/railway-fare-find): I ask nothing of RailRadar's fare service, and nothing is requested until the box is opened. The list of stations is the stations that have a saved fare; the choice is made in the tools' own searchable dropdown. Results follow the card's two switches (only trains that run today; specials) and can be ordered by time or by price. What I say honestly: the date of the OLDEST fare shown, that fares have been collected for X of Y trains (so a train may be missing), that a local train's figure is an estimate from the fare table, and the disclaimer.

doc: The finder stays closed until asked for, so a page of trains makes no request; then it shows the station box

behaviours: the finder is closed at first: a button and one line, no search box and no request (a page of trains makes none)
it sits on the card, above the lists of trains
the trains to a station are listed with their time at Durgapur, name, number, class word, distance, days and a chip per class with its fare
a Vande Bharat and a Shatabdi wear their badges and edges; a local train is violet and its fare says 'about' with its range
the date of the OLDEST fare is said first (12 Nov), then the count of trains, then the ONE-LINE disclaimer and the source in few words
it is honest that only some trains are collected so far, and that 'about' is an estimate, in a few words
when everything is collected the 'may not be listed yet' line is gone
by price puts the cheapest first (the local at Rs 35, then Rs 120 ...), by time keeps the order at Durgapur
the specials switch hides special trains (03008 is one), and 'only today' hides trains that do not run today
when the switches hide every train it says so and how to see them
after the paid month the list is dated in amber and says the fares are no longer refreshed
the list scrolls inside the box and is positioned (a long list must not stretch the window)
